# Expected verdicts for the flat fixture: the specification the sweep
# is built against.
#
# One row per local branch. Columns are whitespace-separated: the branch
# name, the verdict, the reason key the report must carry, and free prose
# saying why the row exists.
#
# The reason keys, in the order the sweep decides them. The prefix
# names the kind of answer (protected, landed or kept), and asserting
# the whole key is what makes a row say more than "this branch
# survived":
#
#   protected:default       the default branch of the repository
#   protected:current       the branch HEAD is on
#   protected:worktree      checked out in another worktree
#   protected:long-lived    a name teams keep: develop, staging,
#                           production, gh-pages, main, master, release/*
#                           -- the whole built-in list, not an index of
#                           rows below. develop, staging, production and
#                           gh-pages have rows here, main and release/*
#                           have them in the gitflow table, and master
#                           has none in either.
#   protected:backup        a name ending in -backup
#   landed:ancestor         already an ancestor of the default branch
#   landed:content          merging it into the default branch would
#                           produce the default branch tree unchanged, and
#                           so would merging each commit it does not
#                           share with that branch
#   kept:commit-not-landed  merging the branch adds nothing, but a commit
#                           on it would: content that reached no other
#                           branch, which no ref would reach once this
#                           branch is deleted
#   kept:conflict           that merge conflicts, so the check cannot say
#                           either way
#   kept:not-landed         the merge runs cleanly and produces a
#                           different tree, so the branch adds something
#                           the default branch does not have
#
# kept:conflict and kept:not-landed both end in a keep, and the
# difference between them is the point: the first is an unanswered
# question, the second is a positive local fact.
#
# branch              verdict reason                  why
main                  KEEP    protected:default       the default branch, and decided by that rule first; the long-lived list holds main too, so this row's VERDICT survives losing the default-branch rule and only its reason catches that
o-current             KEEP    protected:current       an ancestor at the default branch's tip; only being checked out saves it
develop               KEEP    protected:long-lived    an ancestor; only the name saves it
staging               KEEP    protected:long-lived    an ancestor; only the name saves it
production            KEEP    protected:long-lived    an ancestor; only the name saves it
gh-pages              KEEP    protected:long-lived    an ancestor; only the name saves it
r-spike-backup        KEEP    protected:backup        an ancestor; only the -backup suffix saves it
n-worktree            KEEP    protected:worktree      an ancestor, and checked out elsewhere
p1-ancestor           DELETE  landed:ancestor         merged with a real merge commit
a-squash-clean        DELETE  landed:content          squash-merged; the default branch later moved on
c-merged-main-back    DELETE  landed:content          squash-merged, then the default branch merged back in
b-main-edited         KEEP    kept:conflict           squash-merged, then the same lines were edited
e-parent              KEEP    kept:not-landed         never merged anywhere
e-stacked-child       KEEP    kept:not-landed         merged into its parent, not the default branch
s-tag-shadow          KEEP    kept:not-landed         work never landed; a tag of the same name points at the default branch
u-added-then-removed  KEEP    kept:commit-not-landed  added a file and removed it, so it adds nothing while holding the only copy of what it added
